jamal: FYI I'm hitting a confusing embeddings shape bug in the JS SDK during the new-hire sample app walkthrough. Single input OK, batches sometimes malformed.

jamal: Quick example: call embeddings.create({ input: ['x','y'] }) -> res.embeddings prints like: [[v_x], v_y] or sometimes [v_x, v_y] where v_x is length 3072.

evie: do you have the raw server response?

jamal: server response JSON is fine: data: [{embedding:[...1536...]},{embedding:[...1536...]}]. This looks like client-side helper normalization or retry merge bug.

olga: we added a "fast-path" that returns single vectors without wrapping in some places. If a retry path concatenates chunks then shapes could get mixed. Also saw one case where auth refresh triggered a retry mid-body.

jamal: repro steps: set REDWOOD_API_KEY to expire quickly, run examples/batch-onboard.js which calls embeddings in parallel, observe sometimes malformed shapes and occasional duplicated vectors in DB.

evie: proposed fixes: 1) add normalizeEmbeddings() in SDK to coerce to Array<Array<number>> and validate dims; 2) make retry code discard partial merged bodies and reissue full request after refresh; 3) throw EmbeddingShapeError with expected/actual when mismatch detected so onboarding UX is clearer.

olga: I'll file DEVEX-4287 and add unit tests that simulate token refresh mid-stream and partial JSON merges. Also update sample app to use ensureVectors(resp) helper and add note in README.

ci-bot: Created issue DEVEX-4287 "js-sdk: normalize embeddings + fix retry merge" by olga (https://tracker/redwood/DEVEX-4287) :white_check_mark:

jamal: thanks, with the normalize helper my local runs look stable. leaving for QA to validate across node versions.

evie: thanks, will include changelog entry "fix(embeddings): normalize batch shapes; prevent retry merge".
